name: Handout 5: The Encoded Letter
player_description:
ENCODED TEXT:
Cqn arcrxvpe expde: Aqr xqrjxbqe jcbq. Dkb jcbq xrrno Kbc. Dkb jcbq eba Kbe kbbi ecba kbi. Ebo jcbq. Ebo rea ebo. M.J.E.

[Caesar cipher, shift 3 — hint printed faint on reverse]

PLAINTEXT:
The artifact must not reach Rome. By any means necessary. Our mutual friend's ambitions depend on its permanent removal. You know what to do.

Signed: G.C.B.
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 2, when the party searches the Tribune's quarters. DC 14 Investigation to locate.
HOW: Tea-stain the paper, fold twice. Print 'Caesar cipher, shift 3' faint on the reverse for players who check.
WHAT IT REVEALS: G.C.B. = Gaius Cassius Brutus. The Tribune is working for a private patron, not the Senate's legitimate interest. 'Permanent removal' means destroy — someone with enormous influence wants the spear gone before it complicates something larger. This is the first direct link to Brutus.
